title_zh: 暂不使用草坪并约定检查掉枝的树

scenario.label_zh: 暂不使用草坪并约定检查掉枝的树
scenario.goal_zh: 确认成熟树木掉落枝杈的位置，并约定让访客留在室内、请养护人员检查

context_zh: 两位邻居在室内看见共用花园草坪上有掉落的粗树枝，讨论接待访客前的安排。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Olive
sentences.text: There's a large limb on the lawn. Did it come from the tree beside the fence?

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: Yes. I saw it fall from that mature tree a few minutes ago.

sentences.speaker: Olive
sentences.text: We were going to have tea out there with the neighbours.

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: Let's keep everyone inside for now. I don't know whether any other branches are loose.

sentences.speaker: Olive
sentences.text: I'll tell the visitors we're using the sitting room, not the lawn.

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: And I'll contact the tree-care team to inspect the tree. We shouldn't assume the rest of it is fine just because only one branch fell.

sentences.speaker: Olive
sentences.text: Agreed. The garden can wait until we've had it checked.
